evaluation_clock.rule: Only observations actually released and available at or before the cutoff may enter that Friday's candidate score.

source_rules.release_schedule: H.10 releases the previous business week's daily dollar-index observations on Monday at 16:15 ET; holiday Monday shifts to the next business day.
source_rules.point_in_time_rule: For Friday t, use the latest H.10 observation whose scheduled H.10 release occurred on or before Friday t cutoff. This normally excludes the current business week's observations.

source_rules.release_schedule: Daily EIA spot series; release timing must be evidenced for historical point-in-time use before real-data research.
source_rules.point_in_time_rule: Use the latest positive WTI observation with documented release timestamp <= cutoff. If historical release timestamps are unavailable, no real-data run is allowed until a conservative fixed-lag rule is separately approved.

source_rules.release_schedule: Chicago Fed NFCI is updated Wednesday 08:30 ET and covers the previous Friday; Thursday on certain holiday weeks.
source_rules.point_in_time_rule: For Friday t, the newest eligible NFCI observation is the prior Friday's index value if its Wednesday/Thursday release occurred by cutoff.

source_rules.release_schedule: Weekly index ending Friday; recent releases occur during the following week.
source_rules.point_in_time_rule: Use only an ending-Friday value whose actual release timestamp is <= cutoff. Without historical release timestamps, require at least a seven-calendar-day observation lag.

source_rules.release_schedule: H.4.1 Wednesday level, normally released Thursday.
source_rules.point_in_time_rule: For Friday t, current-week Wednesday level may be used only if its H.4.1 release occurred by cutoff.

source_rules.release_schedule: H.15 is posted each business day at 16:15 ET and generally publishes the prior business day's selected rates.
source_rules.point_in_time_rule: Use the latest H.15 observation whose H.15 release is <= cutoff; do not assume Friday observation is available on Friday unless the release proves it.

source_rules.release_schedule: H.15 is posted each business day at 16:15 ET.
source_rules.point_in_time_rule: Use the latest H.15 observation whose release is <= cutoff.

source_rules.release_schedule: H.15 is posted each business day at 16:15 ET.
source_rules.point_in_time_rule: Use the latest H.15 observation whose release is <= cutoff.

transformation_rationale.USD: Level measures the prevailing broad-dollar regime rather than only weekly impulse.
transformation_rationale.ENERGY: Natural log preserves price-level information while reducing multiplicative scale/skew effects.
transformation_rationale.FIN_CONDITIONS: NFCI level directly represents tight versus loose financial conditions.
transformation_rationale.FIN_STRESS: STLFSI4 level directly represents above- versus below-normal financial stress.
transformation_rationale.LIQUIDITY: A 13-week log change measures balance-sheet liquidity impulse and avoids treating the long-run WALCL level trend as a permanent regime signal.
transformation_rationale.REAL_YIELD: Level captures the prevailing real-rate pressure relevant to USD conditions.
transformation_rationale.UST_2Y: Level captures front-end nominal policy-rate pressure.

normalization.history_scope: strictly prior complete candidate weeks only

review_gates.note: Review gates require explanation and may cause rejection, but are not silently retuned after results are visible.

anti_tuning_rules: No transform may change after candidate results are viewed without a new preregistration version.
No hard acceptance threshold may be relaxed after results are viewed.
No slot may be dropped or reweighted to rescue a failed candidate.
No replacement proxy may be introduced without a new preregistration.
No current-week observation may enter normalization history.
No historical observation may be treated as available before its actual or conservatively documented release time.
No predictive investment-performance claim is authorized.
